lead_raw_text:
The structure of LuMnAs2 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 16-atom unit cell (Lu4Mn4As8) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Mn centers as tetrahedral, each coordinated by four As neighbors, while Lu centers show eight geometric neighbors (six As, two Lu) and As centers have nine neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Mn tetrahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between As and Mn polyhedra.
